rows.name: Irlanda
rows.why: Primul loc din UE și din OCDE la citire (516) și rezultate bune la științe (504); predare în engleză, deci acces ușor pentru familiile care se mută.
rows.whyEn: First in the EU and the OECD in reading (516) and good science results (504); teaching in English, so easy access for families who move there.

rows.vwhyEn: The scores come from PISA 2022, an independent OECD test applied to representative samples; the country has taken part in many PISA cycles, and the results are in line with other international assessments. The OECD flagged that the 2022 sample did not fully meet the standards (participation below the threshold), so the results should be read with caution. As a stress test, the pandemic: in mathematics, the score changed by -8 points between 2018 and 2022 (OECD average: -15).

rows.name: Estonia

rows.whyEn: Europe’s best school system in PISA 2022: first in science (526), joint first in mathematics (510) and reading (511). Very good results for pupils from modest families too.

rows.vwhyEn: The scores come from PISA 2022, an independent OECD test applied to representative samples; the country has taken part in many PISA cycles, and the results are in line with other international assessments. The OECD flagged that the 2022 sample did not fully meet the standards (participation below the threshold), so the results should be read with caution. As a stress test, the pandemic: in mathematics, the score changed by -13 points between 2018 and 2022 (OECD average: -15).
